title: hunger-quenching norwegian kjottbjor-soaked-flatbread
description: tangy, pillowy flatbread soaked in a savory mixture of kjottbjor and white wine, perfect for satisfying your midnight cravings. this recipe is egg-free friendly and a delicious twist on traditional norwegian cuisine

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: use a high-protein flour for a more tender crumb

ingredients.name: white wine
ingredients.notes: use a dry white wine for the best flavor

ingredients.name: kjottbjor
ingredients.notes: kjottbjor is a norwegian meat and vegetable stew

ingredients.name: fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: chopped fresh parsley adds a bright, fresh flavor

instructions: combine water, flour, yeast, sugar, and salt in a large mixing bowl to create a shaggy dough
knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic
place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rest in a warm place for 1 hour
punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces
roll out each piece into a thin circle
heat a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat and cook each flatbread for 1-2 minutes on each side, until it is golden brown
place the cooked flatbreads on a wire rack to cool
in a separate pan, combine the white wine, kjottbjor, and butter and cook over medium heat until the liquid has reduced slightly
soak each flatbread in the kjottbjor mixture for 1-2 minutes on each side
serve the flatbreads hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley
